Depthmode: linear: in2 R is eye-space z in world units. nonlinear: in2 R is the raw 0-1 depth buffer, linearised with Near and Far.
Near: Camera near plane in world units. Must match the camera when Depthmode is nonlinear.
Far: Camera far plane in world units. Depth at or beyond it counts as sky.
Depthscale: Multiplier on depth values, to fix units.
Fogmode: exp: exponential density. exp2: squared exponential (softer start). linear: ramps between Start and End.
Density: Fog density for exp and exp2 modes. Higher = thicker fog.
Start: Linear mode: distance along the ray where fog begins.
End: Linear mode: distance where fog is full.
Fov: Camera vertical field of view in degrees; used to rebuild view rays.
Heightfog: On: add exponential ground fog below Heightbase.
Heightbase: World height (y) below which ground fog collects.
Heightfalloff: How fast ground fog thins with height above Heightbase. Higher = thinner layer.
Camheight: World height of the camera, for height fog and glow.
Campitch: Camera pitch down in degrees, for height fog and glow.
Glow: Brightness of the horizon glow added to the fog colour. 0 = none.
Glowwidth: Width of the horizon glow (sine of elevation angle). Larger = taller glow.
Skyblend: How strongly sky pixels are replaced by fog colour plus glow. 0 = keep sky.
Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
